title.en: Mira Murati's Thinking Machines Lab releases Inkling, its first AI model — a 975B open-weights multimodal model
title.zhHans: Mira Murati 创立的 Thinking Machines Lab 发布首个 AI 模型 Inkling——975B 参数开源权重多模态模型

searchSummary.en: Thinking Machines Lab, the AI startup founded by former OpenAI CTO Mira Murati, released its first model Inkling on July 15, 2026. The 975B-parameter open-weights MoE model (41B active) supports text, images, audio, and video, with a 1M-token context window. Valued at $12B, the company positions Inkling as a customizable enterprise alternative to rented frontier APIs.
searchSummary.zhHans: 由前 OpenAI CTO Mira Murati 创立的 AI 初创公司 Thinking Machines Lab 于 2026 年 7 月 15 日发布其首个模型 Inkling。该模型 975B 参数开源权重 MoE（410 亿活跃），支持文本、图像、音频和视频，上下文窗口达 100 万 token。公司估值 $12B，将 Inkling 定位为可定制的企业级替代方案，挑战租赁式前沿 API。

summary.en: On July 15, 2026, Thinking Machines Lab — the AI startup founded by former OpenAI CTO Mira Murati — released Inkling, its first in-house AI model. Inkling is a Mixture-of-Experts transformer with 975 billion total parameters (41 billion active), supporting a 1-million-token context window and multimodal input (text, images, audio, video). It was pretrained on 45 trillion tokens. The model is open-weights, released under a license that permits broad use. At a $12 billion valuation following a $6.3 billion compute deal with CoreWeave, Thinking Machines Lab entered the frontier competition with a differentiated thesis: enterprises want AI they can customize, not just rent from a handful of labs. The release marks the first major product from a startup founded by a former OpenAI executive, adding a new competitor to the AI landscape.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 7 月 15 日，由前 OpenAI CTO Mira Murati 创立的 AI 初创公司 Thinking Machines Lab 发布了 Inkling，其首个自研 AI 模型。Inkling 是一个混合专家（MoE）Transformer 模型，总参数 9750 亿（活跃参数 410 亿），支持 100 万 token 上下文窗口和多模态输入（文本、图像、音频、视频）。它在 45 万亿 token 上完成了预训练。该模型是开源权重的，采用允许广泛使用的许可。在估值 $12B 以及与 CoreWeave 达成 $6.3B 算力交易后，Thinking Machines Lab 以差异化的定位进入前沿竞争：企业需要的是可以定制的 AI，而不仅仅是租用少数实验室的 API。此次发布标志着这家由前 OpenAI 高管创立的初创公司的首个主要产品问世，为 AI 版图增加了一个新的竞争者。

narrative.en: Thinking Machines Lab was founded in 2025 by Mira Murati, OpenAI's former Chief Technology Officer, along with several other former OpenAI researchers and engineers. The company's thesis was that the market's move toward renting API access from a small number of frontier labs left enterprise customers with limited control, customization, and transparency. Inkling is the first public expression of that thesis. The model's architecture — a 975B MoE with 41B active parameters — places it in the same efficiency tier as DeepSeek V4 (1.6T/49B active) and Kimi K3 (2.8T/?? active), using sparse activation to keep inference costs manageable. Its 45-trillion-token training run (spanning text, images, audio, and video) and 1M-token context window put it in the competitive range with GPT-5.6, Claude Sonnet 5, and Gemini. The open-weights release signals a bet that enterprises, governments, and regulated industries want the ability to fine-tune, audit, and self-host models rather than being locked into proprietary API relationships. The timing of the July 15 release was notable: it landed in the same week that the AI price war drove frontier token costs down 5-10x. Cheaper inference favors Thinking Machines' open-weights argument — if running your own model is now far cheaper, the value prop for 'rented' APIs weakens further. The market reception was strong: TechCrunch, Bloomberg, WIRED, Axios, and Fortune all covered the launch. At a $12 billion valuation, Thinking Machines Lab is now one of the most valuable AI startups without a frontier flagship model — a bet that Inkling is the first step in that trajectory.
narrative.zhHans: Thinking Machines Lab 由 OpenAI 前 CTO Mira Murati 与数位前 OpenAI 研究员和工程师于 2025 年共同创立。该公司的核心理念是，市场向从少数前沿实验室租赁 API 的方向发展，使企业客户在控制权、定制化和透明度方面受到限制。Inkling 是该理念的首次公开表达。该模型的架构——975B MoE 搭配 41B 活跃参数——使其与 DeepSeek V4（1.6T/49B 活跃）和 Kimi K3（2.8T/?? 活跃）处于相同的效率梯队，通过稀疏激活来保持推理成本可控。其 45 万亿 token 的训练规模（涵盖文本、图像、音频和视频）和 100 万 token 上下文窗口使其与 GPT-5.6、Claude Sonnet 5 和 Gemini 处于竞争区间。开源权重发布表明，公司押注于企业、政府和受监管行业希望获得微调、审计和自托管模型的能力，而非被锁定在专有 API 关系中。7 月 15 日的发布时机值得注意：它恰逢 AI 价格战将前沿 token 成本压低 5-10 倍的同一周。更便宜的推理有利于 Thinking Machines 的开源权重论点——如果自己运行模型现在便宜得多，那么"租赁"API 的价值主张就会进一步削弱。市场反响强劲：TechCrunch、Bloomberg、WIRED、Axios 和 Fortune 均报道了此次发布。以 $12B 估值，Thinking Machines Lab 现已成为最有价值的 AI 初创公司之一，标志着 Inkling 是这一轨迹的第一步。

description.en: The release of Inkling by a startup founded by former OpenAI leadership validates an alternative model for frontier AI: open-weights, customizable, self-hosted — rather than API-rental-only.
description.zhHans: 由前 OpenAI 领导层创立的初创公司发布 Inkling，验证了前沿 AI 的另一种模式：开源权重、可定制、可自托管——而非仅限 API 租赁。

description.en: At $12B valuation with $6.3B compute deal locked in, Thinking Machines Lab adds a major competitor to the frontier AI market, challenging the notion that only a handful of labs can produce competitive models.
description.zhHans: 以 $12B 估值锁定 $6.3B 算力交易，Thinking Machines Lab 为前沿 AI 市场增加了一个主要竞争者，挑战了只有少数实验室才能生产竞争性模型的观点。

text.en: Thinking Machines Lab released Inkling on July 15, 2026 — a 975B-parameter MoE open-weights model with 41B active parameters, 1M-token context, and multimodal capabilities.

text.en: Thinking Machines Lab was valued at $12 billion with a $6.3 billion compute deal locked in through 2029.

sources.quote: 975B total parameters, 41B active, 1M context window, pretrained on 45T tokens of text, images, audio and video.
Thinking Machines Lab released its first in-house AI model Wednesday morning, called Inkling.
Thinking Machines Lab is releasing its first AI model, more than a year after former OpenAI executive Mira Murati founded the startup.
Inkling, a 975-billion-parameter open source model, was trained to understand video and audio.
Mira Murati's Thinking Machines on Wednesday released Inkling, betting enterprises want AI they can customize.
Valued at $12 billion, just launched Inkling — an open-weight model designed to rival OpenAI.
